messages:
alex: quick thought — can we make the deploy bot open a small modal when someone runs /deploy?
It would capture pin, change-window, short release notes, and a single 'escape hatch' action.

maria: yes please. modal should prefill image pins from the manifest and let you pick a rollback policy dropdown.
Also add a tiny template picker for release notes (quickpatch / patch / minor).

sam: +1. add a severity radio (monitor / throttle / immediate rollback) so on-call knows how urgent it is.
Also add a checkbox to auto-notify #product and #infra.

jin: rough prototype for command and payload:
```
/deploy start --modal
payload: {
  pin: "service-api@sha256:abcd1234",
  change_window: "2026-03-21T22:00Z",
  notes_template: "quickpatch",
  rollback_policy: "soft",
  escape_hatch: true
}
```
This would surface in the modal and then call the usual deploy pipeline.

alex: nice. UX notes: the escape hatch should require a short reason and an emoji confirmation (two-step) to avoid accidental rollbacks.

release-bot: Deploy action queued by @alex — pipeline: release/canary -> auto-checks -> promote.
Status: queued (build 5421). :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: template example for release notes in modal: one-line summary + impacted routes + rollback command snippet. keep it copy+pasta friendly.
Example: "fix(metrics): avoid double emit on warm-start — affects /v1/metrics — rollback: `deploy rollback service-api --to=release-20260320`"

devx-bot: suggestion: persist the modal selections as named templates. command: `deploy template save "quickpatch" --pin ${pin} --notes-template quickpatch`
That way the modal can show a saved list and prefill everything.

sam: ops question — how does this affect scheduled change windows? modal should show conflicts and suggest nearest window or let you force with a reason.

jin: implementable notes: we can reuse the existing slash command handler and pop a Slack modal using views.open. modal schema ~ 6 fields. backend will validate pins and call deploy service via the same API path.
I can PR a small PoC this week.

alex: +1 on PR. let's also add a tiny test harness for the modal flow in the release-bot integration tests so we don't regress.

maria: can someone prototype the modal layout? I'll grab the copy for the templates and product notification flows.

sam: I can take the change-window conflict check and notification bits.

jin: I'll open a draft PR: github.com/redwood/release-bot/pull/xxx with screenshots and modal JSON. will ping here when ready.

release-bot: Build 5421 started (canary). Will post updates in-thread. :rocket:
